headline: Zero Fox Given Plays Nobody, Still Loses
subhead: Thug Life ran the night with 107 points, Victor Wembanyama swatted 5 shots, and Zero Fox Given never checked in.

zingers.line: Zero Fox Given put zero players on the floor and still found a way to lose the night 1-7.
Julius Randle went 0 for 7 from three with 5 turnovers; BrookynDynasty needed an empty roster across the table to win.
Thug Life used seven players to win the night, and Karl-Anthony Towns still handed over 7 turnovers in a 4-7 hole.
Luka Dončić dropped 41 and Acinonyx still trails LeParth James 9-2 while Precious Achiuwa went 2 for 6.
MONSTARS ☄️ started Duncan Robinson at Util and got 4 for 14 shooting, now down 3-6 to Gopher Gold.
Jayson Tatum scored 40 and theInfamous still lost the night 5-6 to Nova Knicks; Darius Acuff Jr. bricked 8 for 20.
White Mambas trail Suggs to be you 2-8, so they dumped Neemias Queta and went shopping on the wire overnight.

night: Victor Wembanyama posted 29 points, 10 rebounds and 5 blocks on 14 for 21 shooting for Nova Knicks, the best line of the night.
Julius Randle went 0 for 7 from three with 5 turnovers for BrookynDynasty, the worst brick of the night.
Zero Fox Given did not have a single player take the floor and lost the night 1-7 to BrookynDynasty anyway.
Nova Knicks cut De'Andre Hunter yesterday morning, then he scored 24 with 5 threes on 8 for 13 shooting; he is still on the wire.
Thug Life won the night with 107 points and 33 defensive rebounds and still trails Adam Silver Dez Nuts 4-7.
